newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Grootvlei, Cons Modder up on buy bid.
newsitem.headline: Grootvlei, Cons Modder up on buy bid.

text.p: Shares in South African gold mines Grootvlei and Consolidated Modderfontein bounced on Tuesday on the announcement that Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd is bidding to buy them, dealers said.
"It is on the back of the announcement. The move is positive for the two mines, especially Grootvlei which is a marginal mine," a dealer said.

Cons Modder was the fourth most actively traded share on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange at 1005 GMT and jumped 12.63 percent, or 24 cents, to 214 cents in a volume of 663,300 shares valued at over 1.4 million rand.
Grootvlei leapt 15.79 percent, or 150 cents, to 11 rand in a volume of 121,800 shares valued at over 1.3 million rand.
Harmony announced early on Tuesday that it planned to bid for its Randgold stablemate mine Grootvlei and Grootvlei's neighbour Cons Modder.
The bids value Grootvlei shares at 11.47 rand each and Cons Modder shares at 229 cents each.
Harmony was also up 30 cents at 39.39 rand in a volume of 60,900 shares valued at over 2.3 million rand.
Dealers said upward potential in the shares would depend on the actual deal and what offer was made to minorities.
